# The Nursing Journey – Siva Naik

> Nursing study materials, MCQs, nursing council registration & renewals, documentation and career guidance for nursing students and professionals in India.

## When to Use This

Use this site when you need:

- **Nursing study materials and exam preparation** for GNM, B.Sc. Nursing, Post Basic B.Sc. Nursing, and M.Sc. Nursing students
- **Nursing council services** including registration, renewals, NUID card, Good Standing Certificate, NOC, reciprocal registration, migration certificate, and foreign verification with APNMC/TSNC and other councils
- **Career guidance** for nursing professionals including job opportunities in India and abroad, interview preparation, resume support, and overseas nursing guidance
- **Clinical and practical knowledge** for nursing students and working nurses
- **Documentation assistance** for nursing council submissions and professional requirements

This site is specifically focused on **Indian nursing students and professionals** and provides region-specific guidance for Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

## Site Structure

- `/` - Homepage with all services and information
- `/privacy-policy` - Privacy Policy
- `/terms-of-service` - Terms of Service
- `/refund-policy` - Refund Policy
